name: GPU BVH Construction via Cluster Merging
aliases: GPU-based BVH Construction via Cluster Merging
definition: A method to construct a Binary Volume Hierarchy (BVH) on the GPU by iteratively merging clusters of triangles. It uses a neighbor-finding step followed by cluster merging, prefix scans for position calculation, and reallocation to compact the cluster array until a single root cluster remains.
summary: GPU BVH Construction via Cluster Merging builds acceleration structures on the GPU using a fully parallel, double-buffered merge-compact loop that avoids CPU-GPU synchronization bottlenecks.
